title: Letter No. 926 — reply concerning a scheduled meeting and an allusion to the year 5711
summary_researcher: The public item page identifies the recipient as R. Efraim Eliezer HaKohen Yolles and states that the letter responds to his report that a meeting had been scheduled concerning his affairs. The incoming letter is not present. The response asks to be informed of good news and develops a Torah allusion associated with the year 5711.
